{"how":"Gather two sticks and one wooden plank.
1. Find trees nearby and chop them down until you collect several wooden planks.
2. Craft sticks from those planks (usually 2 planks → 4 sticks).
3. Locate your crafting table or open the crafting menu.
4. Place three wooden planks vertically in the middle column and two sticks horizontally across the bottom row to form an axe shape.
5. Retrieve the crafted wooden axe.

If you'd prefer I handle the actual movement or discarding of excess items:
• `move_to` to position yourself next to the tree/crafting area.
• `toss_item("unused_wood")` to clear inventory slots.
","what":"Craft a wooden axe.","why":"A wooden axe allows efficient chopping of trees and other tasks."
